how: uv run python tools/mutants.py docs/quantities/qt-b1b/mutants.json --no-baseline --evidence docs/quantities/qt-b1b/evidence/mutants-run.json, after a passing `lake build VE.Scales.Examples`; each mutant is applied alone, the module and its imports are built, the file is restored. A kill is an `error:` line, printed in the run's output tail; the claim names where the build stops. The `-guard` mutants rebuild only `VE.Scales.Premises` and elaborate `Examples.lean` against the Theorems olean already built, so a fixture, not a proof, must fail.

mutants.claim: Fresh: a formula counts as fresh when it avoids the comparatives only; stops at reread_denote (scales_conservative's proof)
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: Fresh: the first predicate a formula mentions is not checked; stops at reread_denote's atom cases
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: StrictLinear: connex made vacuous (`∨ a ≠ b`); stops at intended_iff_degrees in both directions (connex built from `total`, and `total` from connex)
mutants.find: connex : ∀ a b, lt a b ∨ a = b ∨ lt b a
mutants.replace: connex : ∀ a b, lt a b ∨ a = b ∨ lt b a ∨ a ≠ b
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: StrictLinear: irreflexivity made vacuous; stops at intended_iff_degrees (irrefl from the degrees)
mutants.replace: irrefl : ∀ a, lt a a → lt a a
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: the degree classes put the objects outside the sort highest instead of lowest; stops at below_of (the order is no longer well defined on the classes of "as much as")
mutants.replace: ∨ (¬ S.domain d.sort y ∧ S.domain d.sort x)
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: one role per predicate rests on WellFormed's symbol conjunct: with it dropped, more_ne_same's proof stops (the Nodup of the symbols is gone)
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: the reread structure reads a comparative like an equative; stops at reread_rel2 (the roles written out) and reread_admissible
mutants.find: | [x, y] => ∃ d ∈ D.dims, d.same = some p ∧
mutants.replace: | [x, y] => ∃ d ∈ D.dims, (d.same = some p ∨ d.more = p) ∧
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: the reread structure leaves every predicate as in S; stops at reread_rel2 and reread_rel1 (the roles written out) and reread_admissible
mutants.find: relation p vs := if p ∈ D.symbols then
mutants.replace: relation p vs := if p ∈ D.symbols ∧ False then
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: the one-object structure puts its object in no sort; stops at grade_open (no object of the sort)
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: guard level (Premises rebuilt alone, Examples elaborated over the built Theorems): a premise that gives every object each graded word (a threshold the premises must not choose); stops at FB6's #guard (the two models become one)
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && lake build VE.Scales.Premises >/dev/null && ! lake env lean VE/Scales/Examples.lean 2>&1 | grep -m3 'error'

mutants.claim: the same threshold premise, full build; stops at dim_iff
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && ! lake build VE.Scales.Examples 2>&1 | grep -m3 '^error: VE'

mutants.claim: guard level (Premises rebuilt alone, Examples elaborated over the built Theorems): the irreflexivity premise also says every response is reviewed (a premise about a predicate outside the block); stops at every fixture whose models lack `reviewed` (FB1's #guards first), among them the scales_conservative row's #guard (flaggedOnly no longer satisfies the premises) and conservative_false
command: cd lean && export PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH && lake build VE.Scales.Premises >/dev/null && ! lake env lean VE/Scales/Examples.lean 2>&1 | grep 'error'
